'''Jorra''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. It was separated by a massive bridge; the upper portion of the bridge consisted of residences and other skyscrapers, while the lower portion of the bridge contained run-down buildings and was classified as off-limits and uninhabitable. The lower portion of the bridge was home to the [[Crimson Kreehawks]], a gang loyal to the [[Whitescar Syndicate]], and had a large [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-abuse problem after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The city was governed by [[Duke/Legends|Duke]] [[Erron Irbian|Irbian]], who was loyal to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spies]] and collaborators were everywhere in the city, and would report on anything they saw.
